name: Pipeliners - Blog - Cost and Descaling Rewrites
body:
> Blog · Pipeliners · 2026-09-23

# Summary
Two rewrite drafts from Sep 23 for posts that were "Crawled, currently not indexed". Sources: `content-drafts\2026-09-23-cost-and-descaling-rewrites.md` and `content-drafts\draft-preview-2026-09-23.html` (a preview render).

# Page 1: /how-much-does-trenchless-pipe-lining-cost/ (post 13694)
580 words, broken heading order (H1 then H4s), no answer block or FAQ. Demand: 44 cost queries, about 250 impressions at positions 57-80. Proposed focus "trenchless pipe lining cost", a Phoenix title, a 48-word answer block, "six things that move the price", a "why we quote the job, not a price per foot" section, 5 FAQs and 5 in-body links. The draft keeps and leads with dollar ranges.

# Page 2: /when-is-pipe-descaling-necessary/ (post 13726)
3,211 words of vague copy, "pipelining" used as a noun, almost no demand (5 queries). Proposed focus "pipe descaling" and a shorter explainer that supports the hydro jetting and lining pages.

# Status
Per the handoff, the Sep 23 rewrites stood down when it emerged both posts were Scott's. Both were later rewritten under the not-indexed program and went live Sep 28 (undo meta `_pl_backup_ni_20260928`). Any reuse of this draft must drop the price ranges (no prices in new copy).
